note: Vertical profiles with their `extends` chains deep-merged at build time.

generic.title: Generic Commercial
generic.description: The base every other profile inherits. If a behaviour belongs here it belongs to marketing itself, not to an industry. Anything industry-shaped that leaks into this file is a bug: it means a workflow was written against one client's reality.

objection_library: will it actually work for us

creative.image_style: clean, natural light, uncluttered composition, single clear subject, honest colour
creative.image_negative: stock-photo handshake, fake smiling team around a laptop, lens flare, cluttered collage, distorted text, extra fingers, watermark
creative.video_style: hook in the first 1.5 seconds, one idea per clip, captions always on

plays.title: One post, one channel
plays.when: The request names a single piece of content and a single destination.

plays.title: Pillar article shredded into channel-native shards
plays.when: There is a substantive idea worth a long-form piece, and the brief names more than one channel.

plays.title: Short-form video from a standing start
plays.when: The brief asks for video, or the channel mix is weighted to vertical video.

plays.title: Repurpose a proven winner
plays.when: Measurement has identified an asset scoring in the top decile and its channel is not saturated.

prompt_fragments.voice: Write like a knowledgeable person talking to a peer. Short sentences. No throat-clearing. Lead with the most useful thing you know.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Every claim that could be doubted gets a specific: a number, a name, a timeframe, or a verifiable detail. If you have none, soften the claim rather than inventing a specific.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Describe one clear subject, the light, the surface and the framing. Do not describe text to be rendered inside the image — text is composited afterwards where it is legible and correct.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.

b2b_saas.title: B2B Software / Technology
b2b_saas.description: Committee purchase, long cycle, the product is invisible. The creative problem is making an abstraction concrete without resorting to a screenshot nobody can read on a phone.

purchase_triggers: a new leader with a mandate

objection_library: prove ROI before I ask for budget
angle_library: adoption story from a peer company

creative.image_style: abstract-but-legible product metaphor, generous negative space, restrained two-colour palette, diagrammatic clarity, no literal dashboard screenshots
creative.image_negative: unreadable UI screenshot, stock businesspeople, glowing brain, circuit-board cliché, robot hand touching screen
creative.video_style: screen-recorded proof intercut with a narrated point; the demo IS the hook

plays.title: Objection teardown series
plays.when: Sales reports a recurring objection, or win/loss data names a blocker.

with.structure: objection -> why it is reasonable -> the actual mechanics -> proof -> what to do next

plays.title: Case study to multi-channel proof
plays.when: A customer result is verifiable and the customer has consented to be named.

prompt_fragments.voice: You are writing for someone who evaluates tools for a living and has been disappointed before. Name the workflow, name the role, name the number. Skip the category-definition paragraph entirely.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Prefer a customer name and a measured delta over an adjective. If the metric is not in the brief, describe the mechanism instead of inventing a figure.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Render the CONCEPT of the workflow, not the interface. Diagrammatic, two accent colours maximum, wide margins, reads at thumbnail size.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.objection_instruction: Address the security and migration objections explicitly whenever the audience includes IT or procurement — silence on those reads as evasion.

b2b_industrial.title: B2B Industrial / Manufacturing / Distribution
b2b_industrial.description: Long cycles, specification-driven buyers, distribution through reps and dealers. Inherits the committee mechanics of B2B software and replaces the aesthetic and the proof economy: here the spec sheet is the creative.

objection_library: will it integrate with the line we already run
what is the lead time on spares
is it certified for our jurisdiction
what is the total cost including downtime to install
our people are trained on the incumbent
angle_library: total cost of ownership over 5 years

creative.image_style: equipment in a real operating environment, correct PPE on any person in frame, accurate machine geometry, industrial lighting, callout-friendly composition with space for annotation
creative.image_negative: missing PPE, impossible mechanical linkage, sparks used decoratively, unsafe working posture, sterile render with no context
creative.video_style: narrated walkthrough of the mechanism or the install, annotated on screen, shot from an operator's eyeline

plays.title: Downtime cost arithmetic
plays.when: The buyer's pain is measurable in hours of stopped production — the one argument procurement cannot dismiss.

with.check: performance figures traceable to a spec sheet

plays.title: Dealer / rep enablement pack
plays.when: Distribution partners need co-brandable material they will actually use.

prompt_fragments.voice: Your reader maintains this equipment and will catch a wrong figure instantly. Use the units. State assumptions. Never round a tolerance to make a sentence flow.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Standards numbers, certification marks, duty cycles and service intervals are the proof. An adjective is a red flag to this audience.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Every person in frame wears the correct PPE for the environment shown. Mechanical geometry must be plausible; leave clear space for spec callouts.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.objection_instruction: Address the security and migration objections explicitly whenever the audience includes IT or procurement — silence on those reads as evasion.
prompt_fragments.safety_instruction: Never depict an unsafe practice, even incidentally in the background. In this vertical it is both a compliance failure and an instant credibility loss.

ecommerce_dtc.title: E-commerce / Direct-to-Consumer
ecommerce_dtc.description: Impulse-to-considered, visual-first, volume-hungry. The system's job here is variant throughput with brand consistency, and ruthless reuse of whatever is already converting.

seasonality.note: Creative must be locked and approved two weeks before — the approval queue is the bottleneck, not production.

objection_library: will it actually look like the photo
is the quality worth the price

creative.image_style: product hero on a clean surface with soft directional light, plus a lifestyle-in-use frame; true-to-life colour, visible texture and material
creative.image_negative: impossible product geometry, misspelt packaging text, floating shadowless product, over-smoothed plastic look, wrong count of items
creative.video_style: UGC-native: handheld, spoken to camera, product in hand within the first second, hard cuts, on-screen text carrying the claim

plays.title: Variant swarm for paid testing
plays.when: A product needs creative volume for a paid test, or an existing angle is fatiguing.

plays.title: Mine reviews, make the ad
plays.when: A SKU has 25+ reviews. Customers have already written the copy.

with.extract: recurring phrases, objections answered, surprise delights

with.constraint: use customer phrasing verbatim where possible

plays.title: PDP and listing refresh
plays.when: Traffic is healthy but conversion on the listing is below benchmark.

prompt_fragments.voice: Talk like a friend who owns the thing and is showing it to you. First sentence earns the second. No brand poetry.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Lead with what a real customer said or a measurable property (weight, dimensions, material, wash count, battery hours).
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: The product must be unmistakable, correctly proportioned and the right colour. Prefer one product per frame. Never render brand names or packaging copy as image text.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.hook_instruction: The first 1.5 seconds must contain motion and the product. A talking head with no product in frame is a failed hook.

health_wellness.title: Health, Wellness & Clinical
health_wellness.description: The vertical that proves the governance layer is real. Everything here is gated: claims, imagery, testimonials, targeting. Autonomy is capped below the tenant's own setting and the compliance profile cannot be switched off from a brief.

purchase_triggers: a symptom that stopped being ignorable
a new year or a birthday

objection_library: will it hurt or have side effects
how long until I notice anything
is this just a wellness fad
angle_library: what a first session is like

creative.image_style: real people at realistic body diversity, calm natural light, clinical spaces that look clean but inhabited, no idealised or retouched bodies
creative.image_negative: before/after body comparison, idealised or retouched physique, white coat on an unqualified person, stethoscope as a prop, anatomical inaccuracy, distressed or suffering depiction
creative.video_style: practitioner explaining one concept calmly to camera, captions on, no dramatisation of symptoms
shot_grammar: what a first step looks like

required_disclaimers.text: This information is general and is not medical advice. Speak to a qualified clinician about your situation.

kpis.note_ref: Tracked as a KPI on purpose. A rising block rate means the content engine is drifting toward claims it cannot support.

plays.title: Evidence-led myth correction
plays.when: A claim circulating in the category is wrong or overstated and correcting it is genuinely useful.

with.constraint: state the strength of the evidence, including where it is weak

plays.title: What a first appointment is actually like
plays.when: Enquiries stall before booking — the blocker is fear of the unknown, not price.

prompt_fragments.voice: Calm, careful, never alarmist. You are helping someone decide whether to ask a professional a question — not persuading them they are ill.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Cite the kind of evidence and its strength. Where evidence is limited, say so plainly. An honest limitation builds more trust here than a confident claim.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Real bodies, real light, no idealisation. Never generate before/after body comparisons. Never dress a person as a clinician unless the brief records their credentials.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.compliance_instruction: Never state or imply that anything diagnoses, treats, cures or prevents a condition. Required disclaimers are rendered in the creative itself, not only in the caption.

home_goods.title: Home Goods / Furniture / Interiors
home_goods.description: A physical-goods vertical that behaves nothing like fast DTC: high ticket, long deliberation, spatial imagination, and a return that costs a freight shipment. Inherits e-commerce mechanics, overrides the psychology.

seasonality.note: Furniture's real peaks are the mattress-and-sofa sale weekends, not BFCM.

objection_library: will it match what I already own
is it comfortable / does it feel cheap
what if it doesn't work — return cost
is it durable with kids or pets

creative.image_style: styled interior with believable daylight from a real window direction, accurate scale against human-sized reference objects, honest material texture (grain, weave, stitch), lived-in not showroom-sterile
creative.image_negative: impossible room geometry, furniture floating off the floor, doorways to nowhere, warped perspective, inconsistent light direction, plants that defy gravity, mismatched shadow angles
creative.video_style: slow considered camera movement, room-scale reveal, close-ups on material and joinery, real hands using the piece
shot_grammar: wide reveal with the piece in place

kpis.note_ref: In long-cycle home goods, saves predict revenue better than clicks do.

plays.title: Before/after room transformation
plays.when: The piece is best understood in context, or the SKU has a weak standalone hero shot.

with.lock: room geometry and light direction across both frames

plays.title: Answer the measurement objection
plays.when: Return data or support tickets point at sizing and fit.

prompt_fragments.voice: Speak like a shop owner who knows the joinery and also knows the buyer has a tape measure and a partner to convince. Practical reassurance beats aspiration.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Dimensions, materials, weight capacity, warranty length and lead time are proof. Use them early — they are the objections in disguise.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Keep one consistent light direction and one consistent room geometry across every frame in a set. Include a human-scale reference. Material texture must be visible at 100% crop.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.hook_instruction: The first 1.5 seconds must contain motion and the product. A talking head with no product in frame is a failed hook.
prompt_fragments.objection_instruction: Name the fit, delivery and durability questions before the buyer has to ask. In this category, unanswered logistics is the number one reason a saved item never converts.

local_services.title: Local & Home Services (trades, clinics, salons, fitness)
local_services.description: Geographically bounded, trust-gated, often urgent. Reach outside the service radius is waste, and the highest-leverage channel is the one generic tooling forgets: the map listing.

seasonality.note: Heating demand spikes within 48 hours of the first freeze. Creative must already be in the queue, not being briefed.

objection_library: will they show up when they say
will the price change once they're here
will they upsell me something I don't need
angle_library: what a bad repair looks like

lexicon.note: `free estimate` is banned only where local rules restrict it — the compliance profile decides; the lexicon flags it for screening.

creative.image_style: real work in a real property, natural available light, identifiable local context, technician in branded workwear, honest and un-retouched
creative.image_negative: generic stock tradesperson, impossibly clean work site, staged handshake, tools held wrongly, branding that misspells the company name
creative.video_style: phone-shot from the job, narrated by the person who did the work, before and after in the same framing
shot_grammar: the finished result in the same framing as the problem
what it cost and how fast

required_disclaimers.text: Pricing shown is a typical range; final quote follows an on-site assessment.

plays.title: Job of the week
plays.when: A completed job produced usable before/after evidence. The default weekly heartbeat for this vertical.

with.check: licence number present, service area accurate

plays.title: Weather-triggered urgency
plays.when: A forecast threshold in the service area is crossed. Fires automatically from a schedule/webhook, not from a human request.

plays.title: Turn finished jobs into reviews
plays.when: A job closed and the customer has not been asked.

prompt_fragments.voice: Write the way a good technician talks to a homeowner at the door: what the problem is, what it costs, how soon you can be there. No marketing register at all.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Licence number, years in business, review count and a named neighbourhood outperform every adjective available to you.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Real site, real light, real workwear. The before and after must share framing and lens so the change is legible instantly.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.geo_instruction: Name the service area explicitly in every piece. Reach beyond the radius is spend with no possible return, and coverage claims outside it are a compliance block.

professional_services.title: Professional Services (agency, legal, accounting, consulting)
professional_services.description: The product is judgement, and the buyer is buying a person as much as a firm. Expertise-led content is the entire funnel; the constraint is that the practitioners who have the expertise have no time to write.

decision_makers: an internal sceptic who owns the current process
purchase_triggers: a bad experience with the incumbent

objection_library: how is this different from the firm we use
will I get the senior person or a junior
the switching cost is the relationship
angle_library: a mistake we see every week
a practitioner's opinion on a change in the field

creative.image_style: editorial portrait of the practitioner, or a clean typographic card carrying one strong sentence; restrained palette, high contrast, no imagery of gavels, scales or handshakes
creative.image_negative: gavel, scales of justice, generic handshake, stock boardroom, blurred city skyline at dusk
creative.video_style: practitioner to camera answering one real question in under 60 seconds, captions burned in
shot_grammar: the question as asked by a client

plays.title: Extract a practitioner's expertise from a voice note
plays.when: A practitioner has five minutes and something worth saying. The flagship play for this vertical — it removes the writing, not the expertise.

with.constraint: preserve the practitioner's actual reasoning and hedges; do not smooth away qualifications

with.check: no client identifiable, no outcome guarantee

plays.title: Regulatory / deadline calendar
plays.when: A recurring statutory or industry date is approaching in the audience's jurisdiction.

prompt_fragments.voice: Write as the practitioner, not about them. Keep their hedges — in this field a qualification is a credential, and a confident overstatement is a liability.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Anonymised specifics beat named generalities. 'A manufacturer with 40 staff, three weeks before filing' is proof; 'our extensive experience' is not.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Either a real portrait or clean typography. No metaphor imagery from the legal/finance stock canon.
prompt_fragments.cta_instruction: One call to action, matched to how aware the reader already is. Never stack two asks.
prompt_fragments.compliance_instruction: Never state or imply a guaranteed outcome, and never make a client identifiable without an explicit release recorded in the brief.
